title: Share forwarded GMCP tool declarations and task-control dispatch
goal: Vision: V-6. Reduce repeated wrapper code while preserving every public handler and attribute function, exact metadata/schema, argument semantics, policy checks, topic routing, result formatting and errors.

reuse.searched: tools/forward.rs payload/send/forward/policy helpers; mcp/schema.rs tool_def!; tools/helpers.rs external_agent_control; all selected forwarding families and existing behavior tests
reuse.reason: Reuse existing tool_def! and each family helper unchanged; one private macro owns the public wrapper contract and derives wire names from handler identifiers. Share identical task-control ID parsing/result formatting without changing mutation methods.

coordination: Parent owns Board, integration and publication; worker makes no commits, pushes or external messages.

results.metadata: All59 public names, attribute names, description literals, schema expressions and argument binders independently compared with pristine base; added executable Tool equality checks compare every metadata field.

validation.failure: every_registered_tool_has_a_typed_input_schema still parses literal registration calls from the earlier bootstrap implementation; already broken at base6a262d346 and repaired separately by protocol_audit in the concurrent ARGS task. No changes to that integration test in this patch.

integration_dependencies: Concurrent ARGS task replaces stale schema-registration source scanner with executable registry/schema assertions in root socket_parity; parent must validate integrated schema and socket tests.
peer_review: Independent review verified all59 exact declarations, all56 forwarding expressions, task-control semantics, original test prefixes and measured runtime delta. No behavioral or macro-hygiene finding.
limitations: Focused verification does not qualify a release or establish the overall below100k goal.
Added regression assertions increase total Rust source including tests; reported runtime reduction excludes the newly added test lines and counts every line in the six runtime files.
